acceptanceCriteria.text: All four tool descriptions and the ticket.attachments schema field mention attachments as listed.
The new tests pass, and src/mcp/skills.test.ts passes unchanged.

body:
The MCP descriptions of create_ticket (src/mcp/tools/authoring.ts:144), update_ticket (:153), get_ticket (:135) and update_plan_draft (src/mcp/tools/planning.ts:28) never mention attachments, and the ticket attachments field has no .describe (src/core/schemas.ts:223), unlike Kanban's (kanban.ts:33,46). Skills (skills/planner.md:78), the CLI runbook (docs/runbooks/cli.md:81-83) and CLI describe (field names only) are already fine. No skill text changes, so SKILLS_VERSION stays 1.8.0.

## Do
1. src/core/schemas.ts:223: add .describe('Staged image ids (from add_attachment, purpose reference) to show on the ticket as reference images, at most 20. On an update the list replaces the ticket\'s; [] removes them all.').
2. authoring.ts:144 (create_ticket), before "Nothing executes until save_plan.": "Optional ticket.attachments lists staged image ids (from add_attachment, purpose reference; at most 20) shown on the ticket as reference images; they are claimed when the plan is saved."
3. authoring.ts:153 (update_ticket), before "The saved plan is unchanged until save_plan.": "patch.attachments replaces the ticket's reference images with the listed ids (staged with add_attachment, purpose reference, or already on this ticket; at most 20); [] removes them all and omitting it keeps them."
4. authoring.ts:135 (get_ticket), after "capability profile (including reasoning.effort when set),": " reference images as attachments (open one with get_attachment),".
5. planning.ts:28, after "and a kind (work, acceptance).": " They also take attachments: staged image ids (from add_attachment, purpose reference; at most 20) shown on the ticket as reference images; on update_ticket the list replaces the ticket's, and [] removes them all. The images are claimed when the plan is saved."

## Out of scope
Skills, runbooks, SKILLS_VERSION, CLI describe output, Kanban tools.

## Tests
- src/mcp/tools/authoring.test.ts: new it('tells planners that tickets take reference images') modelled on line 309: create_ticket and update_ticket descriptions contain 'attachments' and 'add_attachment'; get_ticket contains 'get_attachment'; create_ticket inputSchema properties.ticket.properties.attachments.description contains 'add_attachment'.
- src/mcp/tools/planning.test.ts block at line 154: update_plan_draft description contains 'attachments' and 'add_attachment'.
- src/mcp/skills.test.ts passes unchanged.

## Rules
This card is the complete fix: nothing it finds is left for a later card. Fix anything that blocks a criterion inside this card. Run the listed tests, `npm run typecheck`, and `npx oxlint` on the touched files.
title: Mention attachments in the ticket tool descriptions
